original.statement: With socket-based load-balancing, Local Redirect Policy now by default redirects traffic from policy-selected node-local backends destined to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends; set skipRedirectFromBackend to true to override.

corrected.statement: CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy gains a new field, spec.skipRedirectFromBackend. When it is set to true, a policy stops the default redirect (with socket-based load-balancing) of traffic from policy-selected node-local backends to the policy's frontend back to the node-local backends.

decision.reason: The upgrade note [ev-fbe2aedc4ddc] explains how Local Redirect Policy already behaves with socket-based load-balancing. Traffic from node-local backends to the frontend is sent back to the node-local backends, and this is on by default. The note then gives a new way to turn this off: set the `skipRedirectFromBackend` flag to `true`. Nowhere does it say what the field did before, so it gives no basis for calling this a behavior change. The CRD validator confirms that spec.skipRedirectFromBackend appears only in the target release's CiliumLocalRedirectPolicy schema [ev-313ddc646740, ev-b059d552dcc2], which means this field was added. The subject is right, but the change type should be "added", not "behavior-changed".
